ownershipReview.cohesion: The Core value owner defines inert reference family, exact declaration and type-parameter metadata; it owns metadata equality, payload-edge mapping and logical value acceptance. Format codecs remain with their existing format owners, and Sema owns projection from accepted declarations. No I/O or new dependency direction is introduced.

ownershipReview.disposition: The accepted RuntimeNormalizedType algebra and source fact admission own the original Sema entity proof. This change compares retained family/declaration/payload metadata at the existing value and pattern boundaries. It adds no registry, secondary source traversal or unrelated mutable state; global and closed consumers borrow their existing source authority.
ownershipReview.apiReview: No public API widening solely for file splitting; no new dependency direction, I/O or unrelated state. Tests stay with their production boundary.

EntityKind now exhaustively projects the public family, and EntityType projects exact accepted Action declaration and payload metadata. There is no executable capability, runtime queue, host dependency or parallel family table in this owner.

Format I/O and source analysis remain outside this owner; its embedded behavioral tests exercise the same type boundary.

corrections: The former universal EntityRef projection admitted Character/Asset and distinct Action declarations interchangeably; typed family and declaration metadata now survive the complete pipeline.
Old static AWBC cancellation fixtures were regenerated through the current original program builder, without a legacy reader. Initial failures remain in the archive.
Source value/pattern metadata is checked against the accepted original Sema proof, including equal type-ID but wrong-family rejection.
Dialogue wrong-family values now fail at shared program admission; the redundant later Style guard was deleted while exact rejection assertions remain.
Native CharacterDialogue test fixtures had reused the Style type for the Character factory receiver. They now use distinct type rows; execution admission is not weakened.
Generic Match remains accepted/published. Separate CLI failures and unimplemented Action emit/receive do not reopen it.
